title: Squeakeasys
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Get your hands on at least 10 copies of the Squeakeasy Entrance Instructions. Return with the Instructions to the Townston Lieutenant.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Get your hands on at least 10 copies of the Squeakeasy Entrance Instructions. Return with the Instructions to the Townston Lieutenant.

Offer:

Thanks to some enthusiastic frisking of the Whisker Bossrats, we now know just how many Squeakeasys there are. And that number is a lot. It seems there is almost always one on each of the main levels of Algernon. Now we just need to find out how to get inside. Whiskers are notoriously dumb, so they are probably carrying written instructions on how to get into the Squeakeasys. We just need to get a hold of those instructions.

We suspect the Flingers are carrying the instructions for the other Whiskers. They are a messy bunch so bring back a couple copies just in case there are smudges or stains. Bring a change of armor too just in case. Just don't ask what they are throwing at you. There are also some new, suspicious-looking Whiskers that might be carrying the instructions.

You should be honored Dungeon Runner. You are the only person we know who is familiar enough with Algernon to make it through safely--you have been in there an awful lot lately. Keep this up and you might become an Unbannable like Agents Fess and Hammer.

Turn-in:

Excellent! You found the instructions and we were right, we never could have guessed this. It looks like you just need to find a current Passcode and then go through one of the Secret Squeakeasy Doors. How convoluted! You might have been carrying a Squeakeasy Passcode this whole time and not known what is was for! Keep an eye out for those Passcodes while in Algernon and you can enter a Squeakeasy on your own.

Wow, if you will excuse me, I need to get a dri...er close these Squeakeasys down. That's what I mean.

Objectives:

  • Copies of Instructions ×10

Client level range: 5–20
